title: cell-op-v1 result and plan
description: Machine-readable contract for the two documents every cell-level operator verb emits (spec/cell-op-v1.md): the cell-op-result an invocation reports, and the cell-op-plan a --plan invocation stores and an interactive apply consumes. The CLI emits them now; a read/plan-only Cell API serves the same documents later, and neither adapter may add a field the other cannot carry. Unmeasured values are null, never a default. A plan's digest is the sha256 of its RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON with digest and confirm_code omitted; confirm_code is the digest's first 8 characters. Applying a plan is an interactive-terminal confirmation only: a guard against mistakes and races, not an authorization control.

stamp.description: An RFC 3339 UTC time in whole seconds.

verb.description: The operator verb, as the CLI spells it.

planId.description: A plan id: 24 lowercase hex characters.

optionalText.description: A string, or null when there is nothing to say or the value was not measured.

result.description: cell-op-result: what one invocation did. Exit codes follow the outcome: 0 ok, 1 failed or partial, 5 refused, 6 could-not-check.

outcome.description: ok: everything done (a read verb's unmeasured fields are nulls inside ok). partial: at least one action completed and a later one failed or was stopped. refused: nothing changed. failed: an action failed before any completed. could-not-check: a needed measurement could not be taken; nothing changed.

reason.description: Why the outcome is not ok, from a closed vocabulary; null when ok.

roles.description: One entry per role the verb looked at.

fields.description: Per-role readings, keyed by name; null is unmeasured.

actions.description: Every planned action with what happened to it.

id.description: The action id from the plan.

plan_id.description: The plan this invocation made or applied; null when none.

next.description: Commands the operator may run next, verbatim.

plan.description: cell-op-plan: a sealed list of actions (or, for a batch, of child plans) with the evidence each depends on. Stored 0600 under the cell's run/plans/; consumed by exclusive creation of run/plans/consumed/<id>.

cells.description: Every cell the plan affects, sorted, without repeats.

actions.description: The actions, in the order apply runs them; empty for a batch.

summary.description: What the action does, for the operator.

preconditions.description: The evidence the action depends on: each key's value when the plan was made. Apply re-measures every key and refuses plan-stale on any difference.

children.description: A batch's ordered child plans; empty for any other plan. The batch is consumed before its first child; each child is re-measured and consumed immediately before its own step; a child found already consumed stops the sequence.

expires.description: Exactly 10 minutes after created. A batch's expiry bounds the start of each of its steps.

digest.description: sha256 of the plan's RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON with digest and confirm_code omitted.

confirm_code.description: The digest's first 8 characters; the operator types it to apply.
